Iunderstand presents

1 day without them dreaming
is 1 too many.

NEVAEH and HEAVEN are two butterfly-topped AI voice speakers I designed for children on a wish journey and for the families who love them. I built this with Make-A-Wish in mind.

The answer was always in the photo

The why

The answers have always been there. We just needed one answer to solve the many problems.

Every child deserves to keep dreaming, and every family deserves a way to keep hearing the voice they love. That's the problem I set out to solve.

What I built

Two speakers, one design

4 inch

NEVAEH

For the living, dreaming child. A small voice speaker for the hospital room or the bedside, there to talk, listen, and keep the dreaming going.

6 inch

HEAVEN

The bedside voice urn. The same design, made larger, so a family can keep a loved one's voice close, at home on the mantel or by the bed.

NEVAEH is "heaven" spelled backwards. It's also my daughter's name, and she's proud to have it on the speaker.

Inside the design

Design notes

  • Smart AI processing on board, using an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super.
  • A built-in speaker driver and an onboard Wi-Fi antenna.
  • The silver ring bands light up when it talks.
  • The butterfly stays unlit on purpose, so a grieving family isn't staring at a light. They're just talking.
  • Pink-to-blue finish with silver bands and a silver butterfly on top.

Where it lives

DREAMS glasses

The voice goes with them

The speaker also works as a hub. It pairs over Bluetooth with low-cost glasses, so a child can carry the same friendly voice with them.

About me

Chris Allen · Founder of Iunderstand

I'm Chris Allen. I'm an Army veteran who served with the 1st Squadron, 10th Cavalry (1-10 CAV), and I'm the founder of Iunderstand.

Before I started building AI, I worked in a printing press and in digital media. Now I build everything myself: my own AI, the code behind it, and this website, all from a Chromebook. Not from a lab or a big company.

I'm a father. My daughter Nevaeh is the butterfly in everything I make. I build so that no child goes a single day without dreaming.
